```yaml
name: Agent Deep Modeling

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  set-shas:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      base: ${{ steps.set-shas.outputs.base }}
      head: ${{ steps.set-shas.outputs.head }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set Nx shas
        uses: nrwl/nx-set-shas@v4
        id: set-shas
        with:
          gh-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          main-branch-name: main
          remote: origin
          set-environment-variables-for-job: true
          fallback-sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          last-successful-event: push
          working-directory: .
          workflow-id: ${{ github.workflow }}
          use-previous-merge-group-commit: true

  lint-test-build:
    needs: set-shas
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      NX_CLOUD_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NX_CLOUD_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Lint affected projects
        run: npx nx affected:lint --base=${{ needs.set-shas.outputs.base }} --head=${{ needs.set-shas.outputs.head }}
      - name: Test affected projects
        run: npx nx affected:test --base=${{ needs.set-shas.outputs.base }} --head=${{ needs.set-shas.outputs.head }}
      - name: Build affected projects
        run: npx nx affected:build --base=${{ needs.set-shas.outputs.base }} --head=${{ needs.set-shas.outputs.head }}

  e2e:
    needs: lint-test-build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      NX_CLOUD_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NX_CLOUD_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Run e2e tests for affected projects
        run: npx nx affected:e2e --base=${{ needs.set-shas.outputs.base }} --head=${{ needs.set-shas.outputs.head }}

  all-green:
    needs: [lint-test-build, e2e]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: re-actors/alls-green@release/v1
        with:
          jobs: lint-test-build,e2e
          allowed-failures: 0
          allowed-skips: 0
```
